subject: SAME AS clause
notes: SR6 (--check 13.18.49.3 -> OK 6)). `IsFileSectionItem(item) && HasObjectReferenceLeaf(target)` -> COBOL1556; HasObjectReferenceLeaf recurses the subordinates ('including its subordinate data items'). Probes: p13_sr6 (FD record `01 FR SAME AS OREF`, OREF USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE) -> 1556 SR6; p14_sr6grp (object reference inside the group target) -> 1556 SR6; p15_sr6ws (same copy in WORKING-STORAGE) compiles and runs - the file-section condition is honoured. A pending nested SAME AS inside the target is re-screened when CloneItem expands it at the file-section position. No SR6-specific test (negative/pb183-usage-pointer-same-as is §13.18.60.3 SR14, a different rule). || Editions (adjudicator's statement, normalized to 2002,2014,2023 by registrar 14e): 2002, 2014, 2023 (the SAME AS clause is absent from COBOL-85 and is not in Annex E's 2014->2023 substantive-changes list, so the rule stands unchanged in 2014 and 2023)
